The "BREAKING: tidy up" commits only have the word in their subject line. The "Fix … thing" commits mention `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the middle of a line, not at the start of one.
- **`renames`** (2): `docs/notes.md` → `docs/NOTES.md` (94% similar) and `src/api/user.js` → `src/api/users.js` (identical).
- **`api_commits_by_author`**: Alice Example 7, Bob Example 7, Carol Example 4, Dave Example 1. The count includes commits that touched the old `src/api/user.js` path.
- **`feature_lines_deleted`**: 5. The `feature/export` branch has six commits, and all of the deletions come from "Export: step 2" (`97697ef`), which removed 5 lines from `src/core/a.js`.
